label: rem:color-tube-interpretation
title: Interpretation of the color tube
html:
The terminology color tube reflects two geometric features.

Color. The coordinates r, g, b label the three color degrees of freedom. These correspond, via the S_3 subgroups of S_5 (braid group action(iii)), to the three colour charges of quantum chromodynamics. The color coordinates x_2, x_3, x_4 of the QOU 4-tuple (Bring's QOU 4-tuple) descend to c_r = w_2 - z, c_g = w_3 - z, c_b = w_4 - z upon shifting by the spacetime ratio z.

Tube. For a fixed z \in \mathbb{P}^1(\mathbb{C}), the shifted quadric and cubic constrain the color vector c = (c_r, c_g, c_b) to lie on a curve inside the three-dimensional color space \mathbb{A}^3. As z varies over the spacetime base, this curve sweeps out a tube. This space constitutes the total space of the color fibration over \mathbb{P}^1(\mathbb{C}).

Space-like coordinate. The shift \sigma = w_1 - z is distinguished. It measures the deviation of the C_5-fundamental resolvent w_1 from the spacetime base.
